description: Overlays the authentic 64-ray Rel-Time Sun-Stamp (Option A: pure crisp Sun-Stamp, zero glare, no pill) onto the bottom-right corner of a local PDF or Image (.png, .jpg, .jpeg, .webp, .gif) 100% locally. Returns 'Feature unavailable for this file type' for other file formats.

file_path.description: Absolute path to the local PDF or Image file.

hash.description: Optional 64-char hex hash to generate the Sun-Stamp from. If omitted, computes the SHA-256 hash of `file_path` locally.

output_path.description: Optional custom output file path for the stamped copy.

name: reltime_stamp_file
